subject: Coord: Finity TIA + SCCs + UK IDTA details
messages:
From: Lisa Hall <lisa.hall@finityhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finityhealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial: Finity TIA + SCCs questions

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to kick off the privacy paperwork so we can align timelines. I attached our TIA template (Finity_TIA_Template.pdf) and a short questionnaire that your legal/privacy team can complete. A few high level asks we have now: 

- Are Redwood's SCCs the latest (2021) EDPB-modified clauses and do you maintain a single canonical DPA that references them?
- Does Redwood have a UK IDTA / UK Addendum or will you sign our suggested wording?
- Can you outline subprocessors and where they may be located; do you have a subprocessors map we can review?
- Any limits on logging/audit retention we should be aware of (Finity requires a minimum of 25 months for security logs)?

We aim to complete legal review by 9/24 if possible — procurement is targeting a PO the following week. Happy to set a 30m call if that helps.

Attachments: Finity_TIA_Template.pdf (application/pdf, 160 KB)

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Hall
Head of Vendor Risk | Finity Health
lisa.hall@finityhealth.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Hall <lisa.hall@finityhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: Finity TIA + SCCs questions

Lisa —

Appreciate the materials and timeline. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Marissa (privacy ops) to take point on the TIA and SCC questions. Quick answers up front:

- We publish the EEA SCCs (2021 EDPB-compatible) in our DPA and maintain a redline history; Kimberly will confirm exact versioning.
- We have a UK Addendum template (we typically use the UK IDTA-compatible addendum) — we can provide a draft and accept (reasonable) redlines.
- Subprocessors: we keep a live subprocessor map and can share the current list; most infra vendors are in US/EU regions, with a small analytic partner in APAC.
- Logging: default retention is 12 months; we can discuss extended retention for security logs as an exception tied to contract term and pricing.

Would you be available for a 30m call next week (Mon/Wed preferred) so Kimberly can walk through the redlines?

Best,
Rishi
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Hall <lisa.hall@finityhealth.com>, procurement@finityhealth.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 15:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: Finity TIA + SCCs questions

Hi Lisa / Finity procurement team —

Thanks for sending the TIA. Per Rishi's note, attaching our initial redlines and a UK addendum draft for your review (SCCs_v2_redline.docx; UK-IDTA-Addendum-draft.docx). Below are the specific items we flagged from the TIA and your questionnaire. I tried to keep asks discrete so we can triage on the call: 

1) SCCs / DPA baseline
- We use the 2021 EU SCCs incorporated by reference into our DPA. We will send a PDF with the tracked changes; our standard approach is to accept downstream customer-validated minimal changes, but not wholesale replacement of core security language (we're happy to discuss a few customer-required deletions).

2) UK IDTA / Addendum
- We maintain a UK addendum aligned with the Department of Digital, Culture, Media & Sport guidance. If Finity requires specific IDTA language, please indicate the clauses you need changed; otherwise the draft should be usable.

3) Subprocessors and locations
- Attached is the current subprocessor map snapshot (see redline doc notes). Quick summary: primary infra (cloud) in us-west1 and eu-west1; CDN and logging vendor (third-party) in us-south; analytics vendor in apac-east. We will provide a signed notice for any new subprocessors with a 30-day review window or seek specific contractual approval if a processor will handle customer personal data outside current regions.

4) Logging / retention
- Default security log retention: 12 months. To support 25 months as requested, we propose a contract-level addendum with a per-GB incremental fee for retention beyond our baseline. We need to know expected average monthly GBs of security logs to provide a firm number.

5) Signing mechanics / procurement terms
- Redwood will generally sign a DPA + SCCs as an addendum to the master services agreement. If Finity's procurement intends to push additional commercial T&Cs into the DPA, flag which sections are non-negotiable. We can accept signature via DocuSign for the DPA + UK addendum; procurement PO and billing can be handled after countersignature.

Next steps: can we schedule a 30m call on Wednesday 9/15 at 10am PT to walk through the redlines and logging retention options? If not, provide two alternative times.

Attachments: SCCs_v2_redline.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 48 KB); UK-IDTA-Addendum-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 22 KB)

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
From: Lisa Hall <lisa.hall@finityhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finity Procurement <procurement@finityhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: Finity TIA + SCCs questions

Kimberly / Rishi —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the drafts. A few clarifications from procurement and legal after an internal review: 

- Subprocessors: the APAC analytics vendor is material for us. Could you confirm the vendor name and whether they process pseudonymized vs. identifiable data? We need vendor-level details to run a short vendor risk check.
- Retention: Finity can estimate the security log volume — roughly 120 GB/month. Please provide your pricing estimate for 25 months retention vs the default.
- UK addendum: the draft looks close; we will send any redlines by EOD Friday. If it's simpler, we can proceed on the DocuSign flow for the DPA + UK addendum and then exchange a limited set of redlines via tracked changes.

We can confirm Wednesday 9/15 10am PT — Lisa, Kimberly, Rishi + procurement on our side. Will you send a calendar invite? After the call, procurement will expect either a signed DPA or a list of final open items to finish internal approvals.

Attachments: none in this reply.

Best,
Lisa

--
